messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-2]
- Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now. [valid 2025-01-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-10]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The billing service depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- The billing service ships only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-05]
- On 2025-03-17, Tomasz Nowak wrote the handover document for the billing service handover for Marcus. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- On 2025-11-21, Team Dune reported that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2025-11-21 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-21]
- The billing service has no deploys from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- On 2025-12-23, Team Atlas noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-23]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-09-09, changes to the billing service need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. [constraint; valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-09]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal decided the billing service will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- As of 2026-06-08, Farah is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-06-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Farah is off the Team Dune on-call rotation. [valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-06-08; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-13]
- The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2026-05-18, Oskar picked up the Ember team on-call shift from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
